lines.speaker: centi
lines.text: Boss,

lines.speaker: centi
lines.text: can I bother you for a moment?
What's going on?

lines.speaker: centi
lines.text: Not many requests are coming in, so I'm bored.

lines.speaker: centi
lines.text: I feel like my skills are gonna get rusty.

lines.speaker: centi
lines.text: Can you please let me make something?

lines.speaker: centi
lines.text: Pretty please!
There's a half-finished model kit that I gave up on.
Why don't you ask Liter?

lines.speaker: centi
lines.text: Are you really gonna ask Mighty Tools to finish up your model kit?

lines.speaker: centi
lines.text: If Liter finds out, she'd sic Volt on me!

lines.speaker: centi
lines.text: I did, and she asked me to talk to you.
In that case, I might have something for you.

lines.speaker: centi
lines.text: Oh! What is it?
It's the shower room door in the Commander's Room...

lines.speaker: centi
lines.text: Okay, I'm on it!
Hold on, I haven't said what's wrong with it yet.

lines.speaker: centi
lines.text: On my way!
W-wait!

lines.speaker: centi
lines.text: This'll be a piece of cake!!
You should have listened to the details first.

lines.speaker: centi
lines.text: Oh, right!

lines.speaker: centi
lines.text: So what's the problem, exactly?
I've been noticing a weird sound when I open and close the door.

lines.speaker: centi
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: centi
lines.text: The latch must have rusted from all that water exposure.

lines.speaker: centi
lines.text: Might as well swap out the entire shower door while I'm at it. Sound good to you?
That's fine with me.

lines.speaker: centi
lines.text: What design do you prefer?
A pristine glass door.
A door with intricate patterns.

lines.speaker: centi
lines.text: Okay, so something modern and sophisticated.

lines.speaker: centi
lines.text: Got it!

lines.speaker: centi
lines.text: I'll prepare a top-notch crystal door that's entirely resistant to water stains.

lines.speaker: centi
lines.text: Like the ones you see in a hotel?

lines.speaker: centi
lines.text: In that case, I'll switch out the wall tiles for black marble to match the shower door better!
You don't have to go that far.

lines.speaker: centi
lines.text: I won't take no for an answer!

lines.speaker: centi
lines.text: I'll get the construction started right away!

lines.speaker: centi
lines.text: As for the estimate, I say it'll be around one million credits.
That much?!

lines.speaker: centi
lines.text: I'll discuss the details with Rapi.

lines.speaker: centi
lines.text: You'll have a brand-spankin' new bathroom in no time!
